name: Cake (food medium)
description: Food-derived medium: metabolizable components of Cake [Confectioneries] from FooDB, plus a standard M9 mineral base. Organic components use presence-based uptake bounds; FooDB content retained. Measured compounds with no BiGG exchange are listed under uncovered.

provenance.citation: FooDB v2020-04-07 (Wishart DS et al., foodb.ca). Content sources: USDA.
provenance.notes: Organic components mapped from FooDB compounds to BiGG via InChIKey/name. Mineral base added. Bounds presence-based; foodb_content retained. Unmapped measured compounds kept in uncovered (v2 completeness fix). IMPORTANT: composition values are taken from the archived FooDB 2020-04-07 CSV data release; FooDB's live food page no longer displays this bulk composition, so it will appear empty. Verify individual compounds via the per-component cross-reference links. Underlying content was aggregated by FooDB from USDA / DTU / Phenol Explorer.

composition_provenance.definition: sourced = the cited source states this component; derived = the pipeline supplied it. Classification table: tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv.

components.target_xref_note: these cross-references describe the BiGG id that was chosen; they were not used to choose it and cannot contradict it
components.mapping_note: [CHEM-B12-01] cbl1 is Cob(I)alamin, the transient reduced Co(I) intracellular redox state of the cofactor -- it is not a dietary or medium B12 species. Cyanocobalamin (C63H88CoN14O14P) has no in_biggr BiGG id (b12 carries no formula and no InChIKey and is absent from BiGGr). adocbl (Adenosylcobalamin, C72H100CoN18O17P, ZIHHMGTYZOSFRC-QRVZQHAISA-N) is a real dietary/coenzyme B12 form present in BiGGr and is recorded as a declared proxy for the vitamer group, not as an exact identity.

components.name: Gamolenic acid
components.target_xref_note: these cross-references describe the BiGG id that was chosen; they were not used to choose it and cannot contradict it
components.mapping_note: [CHEM-GLA-02] Companion to CHEM-GLA-01 for the rows that landed on dlnlcg instead of lnlnca. Gamma-linolenic acid is C18:3 n-6 (lnlncg, C18H29O2). dlnlcg is DIHOMO-gamma-linolenic acid, C20:3 n-6 (C20H33O2) -- two carbons longer, a different metabolite with a different InChIKey. The negative lookahead protects the rows where the source genuinely says dihomo, and "PUFA 20:3" / "PUFA 20:3 n-6" are untouched because they do not match the name pattern.

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components). Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
